verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Workers primarily emphasizes CLI-based deployment (Wrangler, npm create cloudflare) and framework flexibility, with docs mentioning Git/GitHub Actions fit into existing workflows, but no direct evidence of a zero-config 'connect repo and deploy' experience like Vercel/Netlify. Community comments even note Cloudflare lags behind Vercel/Netlify in developer platform mindshare and DX.
